needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at this busy junction to provide a safe crossing point for pedestrians.
Add a pedestrian refuge island at this junction to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing a wide road.
Install dropped kerbs at this junction to provide wheelchair access and improve accessibility for all pedestrians.
Install street lighting at this junction to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers during low-light conditions.
